# aquilegia_staminodes
data and code for staminode paper

recommendation_contract.highest_return_first: Obtain 329×599 original author-processed R/qtl marker genotype and genetic map with 231-ID crosswalk and QC ledger; verify actual ID overlap before inferential fitting
recommendation_contract.avoid: Do not equate 336 public F2 numeric aliases with 329 successfully genotyped individuals; do not download 49GB blindly or use unrelated Aquilegia VCF
recommendation_contract.fallback: Use a small, identity-confirmed genomic-coverage pilot only if processed source unavailable, with separate BioSample duplicate handling
recommendation_contract.biological_falsifier: Do actual alleles predict within-genotype presence and whorl position of chimeric AN/LE/FU beyond baseline organ number, and are candidate forms pollen-fertile or ecologically functional?
